identification: Oil on canvas, Mount Roland with farm buildings, cattle and gums, signed Higgs and dated, verso inscribed 'Mount Roland by J. Higgs Jnr 1887'. Joshua Higgs Jnr (1843-1903, working Tasmania). Attribution rests on the verso inscription and signature; AASD/Invaluable sometimes confuse Jnr and Snr.
